run_linear_approx_saliency: run linear approximation backprop on a PyTorch model to compute saliency maps for a given category
run_gradient_to_linear_approx_saliency: run gradient_to_linear_approx_saliency on a tensor with valid gradients to compute a saliency map
run_get_example_data: run get_example_data to obtain a pretrained VGG16 model and sample input image with category IDs
run_plot_example: run plot_example to visualize input images alongside their saliency maps using matplotlib
review_linear_approx_module: review the linear_approx module to understand how gradient-based saliency maps are computed at intermediate layers
